# hindlimb

[Project home](../../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

Source or model data. Refer to the main data guide for units and provenance.

- [data_audit.json](data_audit.json) — Original study source record documenting its data or anatomical calculations; retained for scientific traceability.
- [geometry M2](geometry_M2/README.md) — Source MATLAB geometry and segment tables. The original source label is retained to identify the formulation and data used for anatomical calculations.
- [matched trial](matched_trial/README.md) — Original muscle, geometry and activation files associated with the selected hindlimb walking trial. They document how the source trial was characterized.
- [matched_trial_geometry.json](matched_trial_geometry.json) — Geometry values associated with the selected hindlimb trial; used to identify the source dimensions and muscle-length conventions.
- [model3_parameters.json](model3_parameters.json) — Original study source record documenting its data or anatomical calculations; retained for scientific traceability.
- [MTForce.m](MTForce.m) — Original MATLAB source for the cited study. Open it to inspect its equations, variable names and source parameter conventions.
- [optimized](optimized/README.md) — Activation estimates from the original hindlimb inverse analysis, grouped by source animal. These estimates are distinct from measured EMG and the applied forward excitation table.
- [original_numeric_tables.json](original_numeric_tables.json) — Original study source record documenting its data or anatomical calculations; retained for scientific traceability.
- [Results_Function.m](Results_Function.m) — Original MATLAB source for the cited study. Open it to inspect its equations, variable names and source parameter conventions.
- [source_inventory.json](source_inventory.json) — Original study source record documenting its data or anatomical calculations; retained for scientific traceability.
- [Source_M2_Results_Function.m](Source_M2_Results_Function.m) — Original MATLAB source for the cited study. Open it to inspect its equations, variable names and source parameter conventions.
- [trial_index.json](trial_index.json) — Original study source record documenting its data or anatomical calculations; retained for scientific traceability.
